summary: The owner merged live-trial-schedule.yml (#257): the scheduled workflow that runs the SPEC-07 trial on pss5 with secrets. scripts/ci.py now checks it like the other secret-holding workflows: pinned actions, read-only permissions, a timeout, and a checkout that does not keep its token. It must also run only on its schedule, with no push, pull_request, manual or other trigger. Tests plant each violation and see it refused.
